method.hidden: Graphs have complete physical information; bots rank only visible runs and do not inspect hidden layers. Bots remember tried actions on labelled observable boards; no future-state lookahead or hidden-colour cycle oracle. Not a human win-rate estimate.
method.canonicalization: Colour identity and all special vessel roles fixed; only ordinary vessel permutations collapsed. Blocked empty slot excluded. Won nodes terminal. All legal moves included in graphs.
method.truncation: Only complete graphs prove dead-state counts or absence. A found path proves solvability even when incomplete. Missing paths with truncation are UNKNOWN.
method.counterfactual: Disable one ordinary empty slot; retain empty placeholder to avoid changing min-four validation or special indices. Not a released level edit.
